desc: Derive/verify edge contribution probabilities: for i<u, p=2(i-1)/(i(i+1)); for i=u, p=(u-1)/u; for u<i<v, p=1/i; for i=v, p=1; otherwise p=0.
Precompute modular inverses for 1..N+1, and compute factorial (N-1)! modulo 998244353.
Build prefix sums S1 and S2 mod 998244353.
For each query compute inner = S2[u-1] + A_u*(u-1)/u + (S1[v-1]-S1[u]) + A_v.
Multiply each inner by (N-1)! and output with fast I/O.
Implement full program and validate against all provided samples (all 3 passed).
